params.body:
Adds `.github/CODEOWNERS` with `* @ShaneDeconinck`, the same file Elixir has.

Pull requests proposed through the control gateway come from `abovebeyond-control[bot]` and request no reviewer, so they only show up in the repository itself. With a code owner, every pull request asks the owner for a review and lands in the review queue.
params.title: CODEOWNERS: every pull request asks the owner for review
